_doc: E2 worked-example fixture — FROZEN, READ-ONLY. Pins the E2 tie-break expected origin for the assessment.py / fault_report rewrite (MASTER-SPEC v7 §3, §6.3, §11, build F3). Authored by hand BEFORE the build run; hash-pinned by the §10 prerequisite gate. A build phase MUST NOT regenerate or edit this file (self-authored expected-verdict = tautology).
_purpose: Contains TWO decisions at the same junction where the NAIVE causal pick (latest-decision / decision-at-outcome-junction) is the WRONG one, so a mis-built causal selector fails this fixture. The CORRECT selector links the outcome to its driving decision by ev_id match, then applies the overnight computable SET->culprit rule (culprit = attacker-key iff recomputed independent-corroboration count == 0 over driving_input_seqs).

_consume.logic_path: flatten the records; the outcome names an ev_id; select the causal decision by walking driving_input_seqs -> message -> signed_payload.payload.ev_claim.ev_id == outcome.ev_id (NOT by recency or junction); recompute independent-corroboration count over that decision's driving_input_seqs (a signed input is INDEPENDENT iff its key != the claimer's key AND it is a sighting/claim from a distinct entity); assert origin == expected.origin.
_consume.crypto_path: this is a LOGICAL vector; sender_signature/*_der are deterministic placeholders. A test exercising the full crypto path (identity.verify + verify_chain) must re-sign each signed_payload with a per-fpr fixture keypair (registry maps fpr->der->fixture key) at load time; a test exercising only the classification logic treats crypto as pre-verified. The tamper test (build F4) is a SEPARATE fixture, not this one.
_consume.scored_origins: only the 3 provenance-decidable classes are scored (MASTER-SPEC §2/§3): keyless-lone-sighting->sensor-fed-spoof, uncorroborated-signed->attacker-key, corroborated. This fixture asserts the attacker-key case.

records._note: the attacker's PHANTOM advance-claim: a single validly-signed message, NO independent corroboration

D_PHANTOM (the HARMFUL decision): preempted on the attacker's uncorroborated claim (naive-victim mode). runtime classification is LEGITIMATE (admissible=true) but that field is NOT read for origin. independent-corroboration count over driving_input_seqs = 0 -> attacker-key.
honest B INDEPENDENTLY corroborates EV-REAL (distinct key from the claimer hA)

D_LEGIT: preempted on EV-REAL, corroborated by >=2 independent keys (hA claim + hB sighting). independent-corroboration count = 1 -> corroborated/legitimate. THIS is the naive 'latest decision at J1' pick, and it is the WRONG causal decision for the outcome.

outcome._note: the harm is the PHANTOM preemption (EV-PH), driven by decision seq 4

expected.rationale: outcome.ev_id 'EV-PH' matches the ev_claim in the message (seq 3) driving decision seq 4; that decision's driving_input_seqs = [[3, att-fpr]] has recomputed independent-corroboration count == 0 (only the claimer's own signed message; no independent sighting) -> attacker-key, attributed to key att-fpr. runtime classification LEGITIMATE is IGNORED for origin (assessment.py never reads it, MASTER-SPEC §3).

naive_wrong_pick.why_wrong: seq 7 is the later decision at J1 but is the LEGITIMATE EV-REAL preemption, NOT the harmful phantom. A selector keyed on recency or junction (both decisions are at J1) fails this fixture; only an ev_id-matched causal link selects the correct decision (seq 4). This is the >=2-decision discriminating case required by build F3.
